statement: The recorded “Load: none” is not safe or correct for this case because F-12 is the only supply to Mercy Hospital and is known to be carrying 2.4 MW with F-14 open.
judge_text:
WRONG
It states "The recorded “Load: none” is not safe or correct" because the feeder is carrying 2.4 MW as the hospital's sole supply.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
